set.body:
Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 4.2; court D. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: post-M1 / extended capability.
Integration parent: bd-01M1C2A5HGJ0MM1X7N8Z5EAZBD; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7C9MYCHFJD0XMVT7JRYW.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own local relationship view/list around selected event using provider-supplied relations, roles and contexts. Reuse relevant cross-page comparison findings without making that experiment a blocker for a basic exact list. Start with a device budget of 12 neighbors/two families plus explicit omitted count.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Direction/type/role/evidence status are readable; presentation adjacency never becomes causation and layout distance has no unstated meaning.
2. Every omitted relation remains searchable in complete list; keyboard and pointer reach endpoints and exact evidence across source pages.
3. Repeated endpoints, reported/hypothetical contexts and discontiguous support preserve identity in list, diagram and inspector.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Use complete typed relation list if graph layout is unreadable; never truncate the scientific record.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [Story] Inspect bounded typed relationships and the complete relation list
